IVX HOLDINGS — FINAL REMAINING TASKS
COMPLETE BEFORE CLOSING THIS RELEASE

Do not start new features until these tasks are verified.

PRIORITY 1 — REMOVE OBSOLETE DEPLOYMENTS
□ Delete the 3 obsolete Vercel projects/integrations that are generating failed deployments.
□ Verify no new failed deployment events occur after removal.
□ Document which production platform is authoritative.

PRIORITY 2 — GITHUB RELEASE
□ Fix GitHub token permissions.
□ Create the protected release branch.
□ Create the production release tag.
□ Verify GitHub HEAD equals the live production commit.

PRIORITY 3 — APK / AAB / IOS
□ Generate the final production APK.
□ Generate the Android AAB for Google Play.
□ Generate the iOS/TestFlight build after Apple credentials are available.
□ Verify all builds originate from the same production commit SHA.

PRIORITY 4 — PHYSICAL DEVICE QA
Run final tests on:
□ Android phone
□ iPhone
□ iPad

Verify:
- Owner login
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Deals
- Reels
- Chat
- Landing page
- Push notifications (if enabled)
- Session persistence
- Password reset
- Performance

PRIORITY 5 — FINAL PRODUCTION VERIFICATION
Provide only real evidence:

- GitHub repository
- Branch
- Release tag
- Commit SHA
- Render deployment ID
- Production API health (HTTP 200)
- Runtime commit SHA
- APK filename
- APK download link
- AAB build ID
- iOS build ID or current blocker
- Physical-device QA report
- Final rollback tag

Do not mark the release COMPLETE until every remaining task is either VERIFIED or BLOCKED with exact technical evidence.
